workflows.trigger: A technician needs a mouse-accessible clone, safe fast-forward update, validation, and launch path for the current main Prompt Kit.
workflows.failure_policy: Preserve the checkout and report the exact Git, network, authentication, origin, branch, divergence, required-file, or parity failure.

workflows.trigger: Canonical prompts, policies, reference data, builder behavior, generator options, checked-in HTML, or Prompt Kit interaction contracts change.
owned_scope: integration of the exact validated owned PR head
workflows.failure_policy: Repair canonical sources or contract drift; never weaken parity, coverage, interaction, review, dependency, or merge gates merely to turn CI green. When the exact validated head is genuinely green and authorized, integrate it instead of stopping at PR status.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker

workflows.trigger: Maps, workflow specifications, registries, validators, hooks, skills, reports, acquisition surfaces, or versioned domain contracts are missing, stale, or inconsistent.
owned_scope: integration of the exact validated owned PR head
workflows.failure_policy: Repair the canonical component or registry owner, add a regression test, rerun the first failing gate, then run the full harness profile. If the resulting exact head is green and authorized, merge it in the same run; otherwise name the exact merge blocker.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker

workflows.trigger: A triage engine, workbook contract, schema, fixture, or generated artifact behavior changes.
owned_scope: integration of the exact validated owned PR head
workflows.failure_policy: Preserve protected inputs, reproduce with sanitized fixtures, repair the focused engine, and distinguish static proof from Excel or operator proof. A missing higher runtime proof does not block source integration unless that proof is a declared required merge gate.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker

workflows.trigger: Work is ready to integrate, stacked, divergent, superseded, conflicted, or blocked across branches or pull requests.
owned_scope: merge execution for exact validated green heads
post-merge verification and safe superseded-work disposition
forbidden_scope: merging with unresolved required checks, validators, dependencies, reviews, conflicts, protection rules, or approvals
merging a head that moved after validation
workflows.failure_policy: Default to integration, not indefinite staging. Preserve unique work and repair merge blockers. If the exact head is validated, required checks and owning validators are green, dependencies and reviews are satisfied, and merge authority exists, merge in dependency order in the same run. Stop only on a concrete required gate and name it exactly.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker

workflows.trigger: Prompt language changes or lazy, placeholder, observation-only, status-only, green-but-unmerged, or non-executable next actions are suspected.
owned_scope: integration of the exact validated owned PR head
workflows.failure_policy: Stop on coverage or identity drift; repair canonical registry or builder ownership before interpreting language findings. Treat missing green-integration language as policy drift, and merge the exact validated repair head when required gates are green and authorization exists.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker

workflows.trigger: A skill lacks executable correctness, routing, regression, performance, cost, or token-efficiency evidence.
owned_scope: integration of the exact validated owned PR head
forbidden_scope: moving deterministic product behavior into prose
workflows.failure_policy: Reproduce the weakness, repair the smallest owned boundary, and rerun correctness before accepting efficiency changes. When the exact repaired head is green under its owning gates, integrate it rather than treating a green PR as the terminal artifact.
handoff_fields: merge SHA or exact merge blocker
